segments.text: My name is Donald. I'm a field marketer at SoCal Contractor Exchange. The reason I chose
SoCal to work at was the opportunity for growth. I've always worked outside so I enjoy being
outside but the opportunity for growth was definitely the reason why I chose to work at
SoCal Contractor Exchange. The pay structure is awesome here. The camaraderie, the culture in the

office is definitely second to none. The top three tips for success as a field marketer at SoCal Contractor Exchange would be to ask a lot of questions, learn from the guys, practice your pitch, don't deviate it. They've put a lot of effort into figuring out what works and what doesn't work. Stick to the script. A lot of enthusiasm at the door. Try and interact and be personable with the customers.
